events.title: Update 2.0 — Brand New Demo Now Live
events.summary: Welcome Back to Midnight Scour!For Steam Next Fest event, the Midnight Scour demo has been completely rebuilt from the ground up based on the player feedback, While the core survival foundation remains, the entire experience has been reimagined to deliver a much better, more polished, and terrifying gameplay loop.If you've played earlier builds, forget what you know. Here is what to expect in the new Next Fest Demo:A Shift to Narrative Horror: The game has moved away from a mechanic-heavy loop.

events.title: Update 1.5 — Thunder, Lock Break Minigame & Hiding UI
events.summary: Gameplay & FeaturesThunderstorm: Storm cues with flickering lights, swinging lamps, camera shake, and thunder.Timed Hammer Hits: Break the vise bar during thunder so the noise stays covered.Noise Cover: Thunder briefly masks your sounds from the butcher.Screwdriver Lock Break: New lock-breaking minigame on the cage door.Hide UI: Cleaner microphone meter while hiding; crosshair and inventory stay out of the way.Story Storm Beats: Extra thunder at key moments, then the storm settles back to normal

events.title: Patch 1.3 — Hiding Mechanics & AI Pacing Adjustments
events.summary: Gameplay & Balance AdjustmentsHiding Spots: Reworked capture logic so you are no longer pulled out at random, though the AI might still catch you for continuously reusing the same spot.AI Tuning: Delayed the killer's entry into the basement, providing players with more time to hide.
